name: Privacy Policy
title: Privacy Policy
intro: How BrandKlout handles information submitted through its public website.
notice: Draft website policy for counsel review before production use. Do not rely on this template as legal advice.
body_richtext:
Information we collect

We may collect contact information, practice information and details you choose to provide through forms, scheduling tools or communications with BrandKlout. We may also collect standard website analytics such as device, browser, referrer and page interaction data.

How we use information

We use information to respond to requests, evaluate market fit, provide services, improve the website, communicate about BrandKlout and protect our systems.

No patient information through public forms

Public BrandKlout website forms are not designed for protected health information. Do not submit patient names, clinical information, treatment records or other PHI through these forms.

Service providers

We may use vendors for hosting, analytics, scheduling, CRM, communications and other business operations. Their handling of information is subject to applicable agreements and settings.

Your choices

You may request access, correction or deletion of certain information by contacting BrandKlout through your existing business contact channel. Some records may be retained where required for legitimate business, security or legal purposes.

Updates

We may update this policy as our website, services and legal obligations change. The version posted here should show the effective date when finalized.

name: Terms of Use
title: Terms of Use
intro: Terms for using the BrandKlout public website and information published here.
notice: Draft website terms for counsel review before production use. Client services should be governed by a separate signed agreement.
body_richtext:
Website information

The website provides general information about BrandKlout and its services. It is not clinical, legal or financial advice.

Results

Customer stories describe specific reported client periods. Results vary. BrandKlout does not guarantee search rankings, AI recommendations, lead volume, revenue or any other specific business outcome.

Intellectual property

BrandKlout website content, branding, design and original materials are owned by BrandKlout or used with permission and may not be copied or republished except as allowed by law or written permission.

Third-party services

The website may link to third-party platforms such as scheduling, video or social services. BrandKlout is not responsible for the availability or policies of those third parties.

Client agreements

If you become a BrandKlout client, the signed service agreement controls the scope, fees, confidentiality, guarantees, data handling and other service terms.

name: HIPAA & data handling
title: HIPAA & data handling
intro: Public marketing forms and client data workflows should be treated differently.
notice: Draft explanatory page for counsel and compliance review. Whether HIPAA applies depends on the service, data flow, vendor configuration and executed agreements.
body_richtext:
Do not submit PHI through this public website

BrandKlout’s public forms are intended for business contact and practice-level information. Do not submit patient names, diagnoses, images, treatment records, appointment details or other protected health information through these forms.

Client workflows

Some client services may involve systems that contain patient or lead information. Where BrandKlout acts as a business associate and HIPAA applies, the parties should use an appropriate Business Associate Agreement and approved systems and subprocessors.

Minimum necessary access

BrandKlout’s operating goal is to limit access to the information reasonably needed for the service and to separate public marketing collection from protected clinical workflows.

Questions

Clients should raise HIPAA, BAA, security and vendor questions during onboarding so the required data path can be confirmed before sensitive information is shared.
